items.title: File Widerspruch against rejection of Erwerbsminderungsrente
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid ist innerhalb eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe der Widerspruch zulässig.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 2026-11-18, assumed posted same day. Letter states the notice counts as delivered (Bekanntgabe) 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post', i.e. 18.11 + 4 days = 22.11.2026 (a Sunday); this fictional delivery date is not shifted for falling on a weekend (no such adjustment exists in the underlying rule, only the end of a running period is adjusted). Per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the one-month Widerspruchsfrist begins the day after Bekanntgabe, i.e. 23.11.2026, and per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the triggering day, i.e. 22.12.2026 (Tuesday) - not a weekend or NRW public holiday, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The letter states the postal-delivery fiction as 'am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post' (fourth day after posting); the standard statutory rule under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X is the THIRD day after posting, so this letter's wording is unusual and should be double-checked against the actual envelope/postmark date if available, as it affects the exact start and end of the one-month Widerspruchsfrist.

The letter also assumes the 'Aufgabe zur Post' (date handed to the postal service) is the same as the printed document date (18.11.2026); if the actual mailing date differs, the deadline shifts accordingly.
